WITH region_averages AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), cross_region_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_transaction_amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM region_averages
), above_average_regions AS (
    SELECT r.avg_transaction_amount, r.transaction_count, r.avg_transaction_amount - c.avg_amount AS amount_above_average
    FROM region_averages AS r
    CROSS JOIN cross_region_average AS c
    WHERE r.avg_transaction_amount > c.avg_amount
)
SELECT AVG(avg_transaction_amount), AVG(transaction_count), AVG(amount_above_average)
FROM above_average_regions;
